title: WARNING: This Podcast Contains Chemicals Known to the State of California to Cause Cancer or Other Reproductive Harm

sentences.en: Around the summer of 2023, 99PI producer Vivian Leigh decided her life was in need of an upgrade.
sentences.zh: 2023年夏天前后，99PI的制作人薇薇安·利决定要给自己的生活升个级。

sentences.en: My husband and I were dying to move into a new apartment.
sentences.zh: 我和我丈夫当时特别渴望搬进一套新公寓。

sentences.en: We've jumped around a lot from place to place, and our previous residences included a run-down dingbat,
sentences.zh: 我们之前搬过很多次家，住过破旧的“丁字形”公寓，

sentences.en: a basement studio with questionable structural integrity, and my mom's house.
sentences.zh: 住过结构安全性存疑的地下室开间，还住过我妈家。

sentences.en: So we were ready to live luxuriously.
sentences.zh: 所以我们准备过上奢华的生活了。

sentences.en: And after a long Zillow search, we ended up finding a bougie apartment building in a walkable neighborhood of Los Angeles,
sentences.zh: 在Zillow上搜了很久之后，我们终于在洛杉矶一个适合步行的街区找到了一栋高档公寓楼，

sentences.en: with a pool, a gym, and a God-tier amenity, Central AC.
sentences.zh: 带泳池、健身房，还有一项神级设施：中央空调。

sentences.en: Welcome to the good life, Viv.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到美好生活，薇薇。

sentences.en: But on move-in day, as I was schlepping boxes through the lobby doors,
sentences.zh: 但在搬家那天，当我正拖着箱子穿过大堂时，

sentences.en: I spotted something that slipped my attention during the initial walkthrough.
sentences.zh: 我发现了一个在最初看房时被我忽略的东西。

sentences.en: Stuck to the entrance of my beautiful new apartment building was an ominous-looking sign.
sentences.zh: 在我那漂亮的新公寓楼入口处，贴着一张看起来很不祥的告示。

sentences.en: Entering this area can expose you to chemicals known to the state of California to cause cancer and birth defects or other reproductive harm,
sentences.zh: 进入此区域可能会使您接触到加利福尼亚州已知会导致癌症、出生缺陷或其他生殖危害的化学物质，

sentences.en: including benzene, a chemical used in urinal cleaners,
sentences.zh: 包括苯，一种用于小便池清洁剂的化学物质，

sentences.en: and toluene, a chemical used in common household cleaning products.
sentences.zh: 以及甲苯，一种用于常见家用清洁产品的化学物质。

sentences.en: For more information, go to www.p65warnings.ca.gov.
sentences.zh: 欲了解更多信息，请访问 www.p65warnings.ca.gov。

sentences.en: You can find these labels on all sorts of products manufactured in or distributed to the state of California.
sentences.zh: 在加利福尼亚州制造或分销的各类产品上，你都能看到这些标签。

sentences.en: They generally all have similar language, with buzzwords starting with warning,
sentences.zh: 它们通常都有类似的措辞，以“警告”开头的流行词，

sentences.en: and quickly followed by chemical, cancer, birth defects.
sentences.zh: 紧接着就是“化学物质”、“癌症”、“出生缺陷”。

sentences.en: For people who live outside the state of California, a label like this might look pretty terrifying.
sentences.zh: 对于加州以外的人来说，这样的标签看起来可能相当可怕。

sentences.en: Maybe you've at one point ordered bedroom furniture manufactured in San Diego,
sentences.zh: 也许你曾经订购过圣迭戈制造的卧室家具，
然后发现自己在谷歌上搜索：

sentences.en: Can I get cancer from a lampshade?
But for those of us who do live here,
sentences.zh: 但对于我们这些住在这里的人来说，

sentences.en: there are few things more common or more Californian than a Proposition 65 warning label.
sentences.zh: 没有什么比“65号提案”警告标签更常见、更具加州特色的了。
作为一个在加州生活了一辈子的人，

sentences.en: I've seen them on everything from power tools,
sentences.zh: 我见过各种东西上都有它，从电动工具，

sentences.en: I've seen these labels on so many different things,
sentences.zh: 我在太多不同的东西上见过这些标签了，

sentences.en: that by the time I saw it on the five-story,
sentences.zh: 以至于当我看到我即将搬入的那栋五层楼、

sentences.en: 169-unit apartment building that I was moving into,
sentences.zh: 169个单元的公寓楼上也有它时，

sentences.en: or even question what toluene is.
sentences.zh: 甚至都没去问甲苯是什么。

sentences.en: I just carried on with my day,
sentences.zh: 我只是继续过我的日子，

sentences.en: like I always do whenever I see these labels on anything.
sentences.zh: 就像我每次在任何东西上看到这些标签时一样。

sentences.en: what good these warnings are even doing if people like me are just ignoring them?
sentences.zh: 如果像我这样的人都直接无视它们，这些警告到底有什么用？

sentences.en: Because it turns out these ugly, clunky warning labels are somehow the most elegant solution we've got
sentences.zh: 因为事实证明，这些丑陋、笨拙的警告标签，在某种程度上是我们所能拥有的最优雅的解决方案，

sentences.en: for tackling an even uglier, clunkier environmental problem.
sentences.zh: 用来解决一个更丑陋、更笨拙的环境问题。

sentences.en: To trace the origin of these poorly designed warnings,
sentences.zh: 要追溯这些设计糟糕的警告的起源，

sentences.en: you need to talk to this man.
Who, ironically, was interrupted by a poorly designed warning during our interview.
sentences.zh: 讽刺的是，在我们的采访过程中，他也恰好被一个设计糟糕的警告打断了。

sentences.en: This man, by the way, is David Rowe.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，这个人是戴维·罗。

sentences.en: For 25 years, I was a senior lawyer with the Environmental Defense Fund.
sentences.zh: 我有25年时间担任环境保卫基金会的高级律师。

sentences.en: And in 1985, I wrote a ballot proposition called Proposition 65 for the 1986 ballot.
sentences.zh: 1985年，我起草了一项名为“65号提案”的投票提案，用于1986年的投票。

sentences.en: The mid-80s was probably a wild time to be an environmental lawyer,
sentences.zh: 80年代中期对于环境律师来说可能是一个疯狂的时代，

sentences.en: At the time, Los Angeles was averaging a total of 273 hazardous air quality days a year.
sentences.zh: 当时，洛杉矶平均每年有273天空气质量处于危险水平。

sentences.en: There had been nearly 7,000 accidents involving toxic chemicals,
sentences.zh: 发生了近7000起涉及有毒化学品的事故，

sentences.en: which killed over 135 people in the past five years alone.
sentences.zh: 仅在过去五年内就造成了超过135人死亡。

sentences.en: The California state legislature declared childhood lead exposure
sentences.zh: 加州州议会宣布儿童铅暴露

sentences.en: the most significant environmental health problem in the state,
sentences.zh: 是该州最严重的环境健康问题，

sentences.en: and nearly half of Californians were afraid to drink their tap water.
sentences.zh: 近一半的加州人不敢喝自来水。

sentences.en: It's the giver of life to the earth.
sentences.zh: 它是大地生命的赋予者。

sentences.en: But this most elemental offering of nature to man now carries a threat.
sentences.zh: 但这种大自然对人类最基本的馈赠，现在却带来了威胁。

sentences.en: There are people drinking water that's contaminated,
sentences.zh: 有人在喝着被污染的水，

sentences.en: and they don't know that the water's contaminated.
sentences.zh: 而他们并不知道水被污染了。

sentences.en: The United States does not have a good record
sentences.zh: 美国在保护民众免受有毒化学品侵害方面，

sentences.en: when it comes to keeping people safe from toxic chemicals.
Federal agencies like the FDA and the EPA
sentences.zh: 像FDA（食品药品监督管理局）和EPA（环境保护署）这样的联邦机构，

sentences.en: were created to protect human health and the environment.
sentences.zh: 成立的初衷是为了保护人类健康和环境。

sentences.en: there were still huge gaps between the intent of laws regulating toxic chemicals and impact.
sentences.zh: 有毒化学品监管法律的初衷与实际影响之间，仍然存在巨大的差距。

sentences.en: My favorite example was the toxic section of the Clean Air Act.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的例子是《清洁空气法》中的有毒物质部分。

sentences.en: The Clean Air Act was originally passed in 1963 and is enforced by the EPA.
sentences.zh: 《清洁空气法》最初于1963年通过，由EPA执行。

sentences.en: At the time, it was a landmark environmental law
sentences.zh: 当时，这是一项具有里程碑意义的环境法，

sentences.en: that aimed to set limits on certain pollutants in the air.
sentences.zh: 旨在对空气中的某些污染物设定限制。

sentences.en: David said it was great in theory,
but in execution, not much was actually getting done.
sentences.zh: 但在执行中，实际上并没有取得多少成果。

sentences.en: The legislation said here are 189 chemicals.
sentences.zh: 法规列出了189种化学物质。

sentences.en: Those are the ones we want you to figure out how much is too much for
sentences.zh: 我们希望你们能弄清楚这些物质的限量是多少，

sentences.en: and then go around and start banning them for things beyond how much is too much.
sentences.zh: 然后开始禁止它们在超出限量的情况下使用。

sentences.en: Well, in 20 years, they had managed to set those limits for six chemicals out of 189.
sentences.zh: 结果，20年过去了，他们只成功为189种化学物质中的6种设定了限制。

sentences.en: Chemical companies and lobbyists resisted federal regulation
sentences.zh: 化学公司和游说团体抵制联邦监管，

sentences.en: because they felt it was costly and a burden on business to change their behavior.
sentences.zh: 因为他们觉得改变行为成本高昂，是企业的负担。

sentences.en: David wanted to actually make it in their best interest to change their behavior.
sentences.zh: 戴维想真正让改变行为符合他们的最大利益。

sentences.en: And if it couldn't happen on the federal level,
then it would happen on the state level.
And David was about to get the opportunity to do just that.
sentences.zh: 而戴维即将获得实现这一目标的机会。

sentences.en: there was going to be a big election for the governor of California.
sentences.zh: 加州将举行一场盛大的州长选举。

sentences.en: The incumbent Republican governor had a really bad record on toxic chemical cleanup.
sentences.zh: 在任的共和党州长在清理有毒化学品方面的记录非常糟糕。

sentences.en: And the Democratic challenger was supported by a number of environmentally progressive groups
sentences.zh: 而民主党挑战者得到了许多环境进步团体的支持，

sentences.en: like the Sierra Club and the Campaign for Economic Democracy.
sentences.zh: 比如塞拉俱乐部和经济民主运动组织。

sentences.en: Leaders from these groups believed that they could sway more left-leaning voters
sentences.zh: 这些团体的领导人认为，如果他们能起草一项针对有毒化学品的投票倡议，

sentences.en: to come out to the polls and vote for their Democratic candidate
if they could write a ballot initiative addressing toxic chemicals and get it on the 1986 ballot.
sentences.zh: 就能动员更多左倾选民出来投票支持他们的民主党候选人。

sentences.en: So they needed somebody to write it.
sentences.zh: 所以他们需要有人来起草。

sentences.en: And I was sort of the only guy left in the room.
sentences.zh: 当时房间里好像只剩下我一个人了。

sentences.en: So I essentially got to write the whole thing myself.
sentences.zh: 所以我基本上是自己写完了整份草案。

sentences.en: But passing a law via ballot initiative came with its own set of challenges.
sentences.zh: 但通过投票倡议来通过法律，也有其自身的挑战。

sentences.en: Writing a ballot initiative is different from writing a law in a legislature.
sentences.zh: 起草投票倡议与在立法机构起草法律不同。

sentences.en: It has to work once it passes.
sentences.zh: 它必须在通过后行之有效。

sentences.en: But it also has to pass, which means it has to be pretty simple to explain.
sentences.zh: 但它首先得能通过，这意味着解释起来必须相当简单。

sentences.en: And it has to be pretty good at fending off tricky negative arguments.
sentences.zh: 而且必须善于抵御棘手的负面论点。

sentences.en: In order to appeal to voters, this initiative would have to walk a very fine line.
sentences.zh: 为了吸引选民，这项倡议必须走一条非常微妙的路线。

sentences.en: It needed to have a strong environmental message, but also be simple to execute.
sentences.zh: 它需要有强有力的环保信息，但执行起来也要简单。

sentences.en: It needed to be tough on toxic chemicals,
sentences.zh: 它需要对有毒化学品严厉，

sentences.en: but not so tough that it would be a burden on California businesses.
sentences.zh: 但又不能严厉到给加州企业造成负担。

sentences.en: Which is how David came up with the Safe Drinking Water and Toxic Enforcement Act of 1986,
sentences.zh: 这就是戴维提出《1986年安全饮用水和有毒物质强制执行法》的由来，

sentences.en: According to the core language of the law,
sentences.zh: 根据该法律的核心条款，

sentences.en: Prop 65 would do something new and innovative and honestly kind of wimpy.
sentences.zh: 65号提案将做一些新颖、创新，老实说还有点“软弱”的事情。

sentences.en: if you know you're exposing me,
sentences.zh: 如果你知道你在让我接触（某种物质），

sentences.en: if you know you're exposing me to a chemical that you know causes cancer,
sentences.zh: 如果你明知你在让我接触一种已知致癌的化学物质，

sentences.en: Not putting anybody out of business,
but if you're going to do that,
The law wouldn't ban toxic chemicals.
sentences.zh: 该法律不会禁止有毒化学品。

sentences.en: It wouldn't limit exposure to toxic chemicals.
sentences.zh: 它不会限制接触有毒化学品。

sentences.en: It wouldn't even punish businesses for adding dangerous chemicals to their products or to the water system.
sentences.zh: 它甚至不会惩罚那些在产品或供水系统中添加危险化学品的企业。

sentences.en: It just said that in the state of California,
sentences.zh: 它只是规定，在加利福尼亚州，

sentences.en: if a product contained a chemical that caused cancer or birth defects,
sentences.zh: 如果产品含有致癌或导致出生缺陷的化学物质，

sentences.en: there had to be a, quote,
sentences.zh: 就必须有一个，引用原文，

sentences.en: The law would broadly be applied to all products in California rather than trying to target individual chemicals.
sentences.zh: 该法律将广泛适用于加州的所有产品，而不是试图针对单一化学物质。

sentences.en: It also applied to businesses who distribute products into California from anywhere outside of the state.
sentences.zh: 它也适用于从州外任何地方向加州分销产品的企业。

sentences.en: The idea was that no sane company would want to brand itself with a scarlet warning label saying that they were intentionally poisoning you.
sentences.zh: 其理念是，没有哪家理智的公司会愿意给自己贴上一个红色的警告标签，承认自己在蓄意毒害消费者。

sentences.en: So this law would nudge companies towards the magic word.
sentences.zh: 所以这项法律会推动公司走向那个神奇的词汇：

sentences.en: If a company knew that it was making something with a dangerous ingredient,
sentences.zh: 如果一家公司知道自己生产的东西含有危险成分，

sentences.en: it would reformulate to leave out that ingredient.
sentences.zh: 它就会通过重新配方来剔除该成分。

sentences.en: the product would need a warning.
sentences.zh: 产品就必须贴上警告标签。

sentences.en: And the ideal number of warnings is zero.
sentences.zh: 而理想的警告数量是零。

sentences.en: The Proposition 65 campaign began in earnest in 1986.
not even the people running the campaign had much hope of the law passing.
sentences.zh: 就连发起这项运动的人，也没指望法律能通过。

sentences.en: which I think in the end probably wasn't the best tagline.
sentences.zh: 我觉得最终这可能并不是最好的口号。

sentences.en: He says the initiative came up against some pretty looming odds.
sentences.zh: 他说这项倡议面临着相当严峻的挑战。

sentences.en: The incumbent governor came out in opposition to the law,
sentences.zh: 时任州长站出来反对这项法律，

sentences.en: along with oil and chemical companies and a number of businesses and agricultural groups.
sentences.zh: 石油和化工公司，以及许多企业和农业团体也加入了反对行列。

sentences.en: And along with that opposition came a lot of money supporting the no on 65 campaign.
sentences.zh: 随之而来的，还有大量资金支持反对65号提案的运动。

sentences.en: We only had about a million dollars and the opponents spent almost five million.
sentences.zh: 我们只有大约一百万美元，而对手花了近五百万。

sentences.en: But Prop 65 did have a couple of things going for it.
sentences.zh: 但65号提案确实有几个有利条件。
一个相当合理的环保诉求。

sentences.en: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Actress and activist Jane Fonda and her husband at the time,
sentences.zh: 女演员兼活动家简·方达和她当时的丈夫，

sentences.en: were co-founders of the campaign for economic democracy.
sentences.zh: 是经济民主运动的共同发起人。

sentences.en: Fonda and Hayden were both big supporters of the Democratic candidate running for governor
sentences.zh: 方达和海登都是竞选州长的民主党候选人的坚定支持者，

sentences.en: and very involved with the Prop 65 campaign.
sentences.zh: 也深度参与了65号提案的竞选活动。

sentences.en: Fonda used her celebrity pull to wrangle a group of famous people
sentences.zh: 方达利用她的名人号召力，召集了一群名人，

sentences.en: to hit the campaign trail to raise awareness and funds for Prop 65.
sentences.zh: 奔走于竞选活动中，为65号提案提高知名度并筹集资金。

sentences.en: It had a lot of the really young kind of Brat Pack stars,
sentences.zh: 里面有很多非常年轻的“小屁孩”明星，

sentences.en: but also older friends of Jane.
some very famous and some famous only if you watch TV series,
sentences.zh: 有些非常出名，有些只有看电视剧的人才认识，

sentences.en: but quite a collection of people.
sentences.zh: 但确实是一群很有意思的人。

sentences.en: and Chevy Chase all got behind the initiative.
sentences.zh: 还有切维·切斯，他们都支持这项倡议。

sentences.en: Fox outside of a yes on Proposition 65 party at MGM Studios.
sentences.zh: 福克斯在米高梅制片厂外参加支持65号提案的派对。

sentences.en: Um, why I'm interested in it,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我为什么对它感兴趣，

sentences.en: I think it's why anybody would be interested in it.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是任何人会对它感兴趣的原因。

sentences.en: It's essentially saying those responsible for dumping toxins,
sentences.zh: 它本质上是在说，那些负责倾倒毒素的人，

sentences.en: and situations where it contaminates our drinking water have to live up to it,
sentences.zh: 以及在污染我们饮用水的情况下，必须承担责任，
告诉我们他们倒了什么，
以及它是如何传播到我们这里的。

sentences.en: And I think that that's a real easy thing to support for me.
sentences.zh: 我认为对我来说，这是一件很容易支持的事情。

sentences.en: unfortunately was not available for an interview for this story.
sentences.zh: 很遗憾没能接受这次报道的采访。

sentences.en: The good news is I did manage to track down a clip of her speaking
sentences.zh: 好消息是我确实找到了一段她讲话的片段，
是在一个支持65号提案的活动上。

sentences.en: The bad news is it's only about three seconds long
sentences.zh: 坏消息是它只有三秒钟长，

sentences.en: and she's shouting what sounds like the word jelly bean.
sentences.zh: 而且她喊出的听起来像是“软糖豆”这个词。

sentences.en: The star-studded group crammed into a fleet of buses,
sentences.zh: 这群明星挤进了一队巴士，

sentences.en: which they called the Clean Water Caravan,
sentences.zh: 他们称之为“净水大篷车”，

sentences.en: nine-city tour up and down California.
sentences.zh: 途经九个城市的加州巡回之旅。

sentences.en: As a member of the campaign,
David Rowe got to travel with the Celebrity Caravan.
sentences.zh: 大卫·罗有幸随明星大篷车一同旅行。

sentences.en: we were driving in the Central Valley
sentences.zh: 我们开车经过中央谷地，

sentences.en: and were pulled over by a couple of motorcycle cops.
sentences.zh: 被两名摩托车警察拦了下来。
罗伯·洛和达芙妮·祖尼加

sentences.en: at the top of the Clean Water bus
and were hanging out the roof at 60 miles per hour.
sentences.zh: 以每小时60英里的速度探出车顶。

and the bus driver is signaled to get out.
So the bus driver comes out
to talk to the motorcycle cop.

sentences.zh: 摩根·费尔柴尔德也出来了，

We did not get a ticket.
Signs like this are going up
sentences.zh: 这样的标志正在被张贴，

sentences.en: at thousands of businesses in California,
sentences.zh: 在加州的数千家企业里，

sentences.en: warning that somewhere on the premises
sentences.zh: 警告说在场所的某个地方，

sentences.en: which could cause cancer or birth defects.
sentences.zh: 可能导致癌症或先天缺陷。

sentences.en: are the result of a 1986 ballot initiative.

sentences.zh: 以压倒性多数通过了加州选民的投票。
